pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.8: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.11: karoti vā kārāpeti vā payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.13: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.16: idaṃ me bhante suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.21.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.22: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.23: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.24: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.25: aññassatthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.26: aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.28: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā karoti
